lesson.name: Learn the Queen's Gambit Declined
lesson.description: Learn the ideas behind the solid Queen's Gambit declined for both White and Black.

{Black's h6 advance was premature. How can White take advantage?} 5. Bxf6 {
[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Trade
pieces to remove a defender from d5.]} (5. Bh4 $2 Be7 {Black is OK. Try to
find a good capture.}) (5. Bf4 $2 c5 {Black is OK. Try to find a good capture.}
) (5. cxd5 $2 hxg5 {Black is winning. Try to find a better capture.}) (5. Qa4+
$2 Bd7 {Black blocks the check and makes a threat. Try again and look for a
good capture.}) 5... Qxf6 {Good choice! Black should have accepted doubled
pawns with gxf6. Now White can win material. How?} 6. cxd5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn.]} (6. Nf3 $2
c6 {Black is OK. Try to find a way to win material.}) 6... exd5 {Good move!
What's next?} 7. Nxd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a way to win
material.] [%hint Capture an undefended pawn.] Well played! Black doesn't have
compensation for the lost pawn.} (7. Qa4+ $2 Bd7 {Black is OK. Try to find a
good capture.}) (7. Qb3 $2 Qxd4 {Black is doing well. Try to find an immediate
way to win material.}) *

{How should White respond to Black's Ne4?} 8. Bxe7 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try to find a good way to trade pieces.] [%hint Trade bishops instead of
losing time retreating.]} (8. Bg3 $2 Bb4 {The pin on c3 gives Black a good
game. Try to find a strong capture.}) (8. Nxe4 $2 dxe4 {Black is doing well.
Try to find a better capture.}) 8... Qxe7 {Good choice! The c-file will likely
open soon. How should you control it?} 9. Rc1 {[%wrong There's a better move
to control the c-file. Try to find it.] [%hint Rooks are effective on open
files or files that may soon become open.] Well played!} (9. Nxe4 $2 {This
trade gives Black an easy game and good central control. Try to find a better
move.}) (9. cxd5 $5 {This is a good option, but most Grandmasters chose to
defend the knight with the rook. How should you do that?}) (9. Qc2 $5 {This is
reasonable, but there's an even better piece to place on the c-file. Try to
find it.}) (9. Bd3 $2 Nxc3 {Black has a safe position and doubles White's
pawns. Try to find the most effective piece to control the c-file.}) (9. Qb3 $5
{This is playable, but it's even better to develop another piece to protect
your knight. How should you do it?}) (9. Qc1 $2 {There's a better piece to
place here. Try to find it.}) *

{Black has misplayed the opening and White can win a pawn. How?} 10. cxd5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a strong capture and try again.] 
[%hint Capture a pawn that's attacked twice and only defended once.]} (10. Nxe4
$2 dxe4 {Black has a safe position. Try to find a better capture.}) 10... Nxc3
{Good start! How should you recapture?} 11. Rxc3 {[%wrong Black is winning.
Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture the knight and attack a pawn.]} (
11. dxe6 $2 Nxd1 {Black wins the queen. Try to find a better capture.}) (11.
bxc3 $2 exd5 {Black is OK. Try to find a capture that also attacks a pawn.})
11... exd5 {Good move! What should you capture next?} 12. Rxc7 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a free pawn.
]} Qb4+ {Nice job! How can you keep your extra pawn?} 13. Qd2 {[%wrong Illegal]
[%hint Block the check and defend b2.] Great job! White has a healthy extra
pawn.} (13. Nd2 $2 Qxb2 {Black wins back the pawn. Try to find a way to escape
check and defend b2.}) (13. Rc3 $2 Qxb2 {Black wins back the pawn. Try to find
a way to escape check and defend b2.}) (13. Ke2 $2 Qxb2+ {Black wins back the
pawn. Try to find a way to escape check and defend b2.}) *

[%wrong There's a better move to make a useful pin. Try to find it and check
the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Pin the c6 pawn on the long diagonal.] Well

well in this position.} (15. Qc2 $2 Nf6 {It's hard for White to get further

{How should Black recapture on d5?} 8... Nxd5 {[%wrong White is up material.
Look for a good capture.] [%hint Recapture on d5 and offer trades.]} (8... exd5
$5 {This is playable, but most players with the black pieces prefer to offer
more exchanges. How should you do it?}) (8... Qxd5 $2 9. Nxd5 {White wins
material. Try to find a better capture.}) (8... g5 $2 9. Bg3 {Black's king is
exposed. Try to find a good capture.}) 9. Bxe7 {Nice move! What capture should
you play next?} Qxe7 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a good
capture.] [%hint Recapture and develop the queen.]} (9... Nxe7 $5 {This is
playable, but it's stronger to develop and capture at the same time. How
should you do it?}) (9... Nxc3 $2 10. Bxd8 {White wins material. Try again.})
10. Nxd5 {Good move! What's next?} exd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find a good capture.] [%hint Recapture the knight.] Good work so far! We will
continue the game in the next challenge.} (10... Qb4+ $2 11. Nxb4 {White is
winning. Try to find a good capture.}) *

{How should Black develop the c8-bishop?} 11... Be6 {[%wrong There are
multiple possible moves, but we're looking to develop the c8-bishop. What's
the best square for it?] [%hint Develop your bishop to the center and
defend the d5 pawn.] Well played! It's a little unusual to play b6 and not Bb7,
but here it gives Black an active and safe position.} (11... Bb7 $5 {This is
playable, but it's more active to defend the d5 pawn from the center. Where
should you place the bishop to do that?}) (11... Bf5 $2 12. Rc1 {It's better
to use your bishop to defend the d5 pawn. How do you want to do that?}) (11...
Bg4 $2 12. O-O {It's better to use your bishop to defend the d5 pawn. How do
you want to do that?}) (11... Ba6 $2 12. Bxa6 {Black's knight will be poorly
placed after recapturing on a6. Try again.}) (11... Bd7 $2 12. Rc1 {There's a
more central and better square for the bishop. Try to find it.}) *

{After giving up the bishop pair, White must be careful to prevent Black from
opening the position. What should White play here?} 10. cxd5 {[%wrong There's
a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and make
Black either close the center or give up the bishop pair.] Great move! After
exd5 the b7 bishop is blocked and White can aim to play against the backward
c7-pawn.} (10. O-O $2 dxc4 {Black opens the position for the bishop pair and
White will have a difficult game. Try to find a strong capture instead.}) (10.
Rc1 $2 dxc4 {Black opens the position for the bishop pair and White will have
a difficult game. Try to find a strong capture instead.}) (10. c5 $2 bxc5 {
After dxc5 White's c5-pawn will be weak. Try to find a stronger pawn move.}) *

{How should Black force exchanges and reach a promising position?} 11... Ne4 {
[%wrong There's a stronger move. Look for a way to centralize a knight and try
again.] [%hint Centralize a knight and offer a bishop trade.]} (11... cxd4 $5 {
This is a fine capture, but it's even better to centralize a knight. How
should you do that?}) (11... dxc4 $5 {This is a fine capture, but it's even
better to centralize a knight. How should you do that?}) (11... Nh5 $2 12. Bxe7
{There's a more active knight move. Try to find it.}) 12. Bxe7 {Good start!
What should you capture next?} Qxe7 {[%wrong White wins material. Try to find
a good capture.] [%hint Recapture the bishop.]} (12... Nxc3 $5 {This is
playable, but most top players try another capture. What is it?}) 13. cxd5 {
Good choice! How should you recapture?} exd5 {[%wrong White wins material. Try
again.] [%hint Recapture and defend your knight on e4.] Good work! Black has
an active position.} (13... Nxc3 $5 {This is playable, but most Grandmasters
prefer another capture. What do they play?}) (13... cxd4 $2 14. Nxe4 {White
wins a piece. Try again.}) (13... Bxd5 $2 14. Bxe4 {White wins material. Try
again.}) *

{White threatens to establish a big center with pawns on e4 and d4. How should
Black fight back in the center?} 11... e5 {[%wrong There's a better move to
fight for the center. Try to find a good way to attack d4.] [%hint Attack d4
with a center pawn.]} (11... c5 $5 {This is reasonable, but there's a more
popular option to attack d4. Try to find it.}) (11... b6 $2 12. e4 {White
takes over the center. Try to find a way to attack the d4 pawn immediately.}) (
11... Qb6 $2 12. Bb3 {The queen will be vulnerable on b6. Try to find a
stronger move.}) 12. h3 {Good choice! How should you trade off a White center
pawn?} exd4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Look for a good capture.] [%hint
Trade pawns.] Well played! After White's exd4, the players reached a roughly
even isolated pawn position.} *
